question: A BJT is initially tested in a circuit where it draws an Emitter current of $8.400\text{ mA}$ and a corresponding Collector current of $8.232\text{ mA}$. The same transistor is then removed and wired into a Common Emitter amplifier circuit. If the amplifier biases the base with a current of $50\text{ } \mu\text{A}$, what will be the resulting Collector current? (Assume the transistor parameters remain constant).
